4919 sunthrupto {soon-throop'-to}

源自 4862 與 thrupto (弄碎); 動詞

欽定本 - break 1; 1

1) 破成碎片
2) 傷了一個人的心 (#徒21:13|)
record.edic_text:
4919 sunthrupto {soon-throop'-to}

from 4862 and thrupto (to crumble);; v

AV - break 1; 1

1) break in pieces, to crush
2) metaph.
   2a) to break one's heart
   2b) to deprive of strength and courage, dispirit, incapacitate for
       enduring trials
